subject: Request: temporary reservation hold + short-term H100 substitution for Horizon Labs
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditi Verma <aditi@horizonlabs.ai>, Michael Chu <michael.chu@horizonlabs.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary reservation hold + short-term H100 substitution for Horizon Labs

Team —

Horizon Labs just confirmed an unexpected one-week training sprint starting next Monday; their forecasted token throughput will exceed their dedicated commit for 7 days. They asked whether we can: 1) place a 7-day reservation hold on their existing Dedicated window while they run the sprint, and 2) temporarily map their reserved SKU to H100 variants for that window (their models perform ~2.5x faster on H100 and this avoids multi-day throttling).

Why this matters: Horizon is mid-enterprise but this sprint drives a near-term upsell conversation (RL bench + longer-term commit). If we deny, they will either delay the sprint (risking churn of the upsell motion) or run on spot which will degrade throughput and likely generate a support escalation.

Summary of ask: 
- Reservation hold: 7 days (week of Jul 26–Aug 2)
- Temporary SKU substitution: map reserved capacity to H100-equivalent instances for that week
- Overage policy: Horizon requests capped overage rate (no more than 50% premium to committed rate) during the hold window

Attachments: Horizon_capacity_plan.xlsx (usage curve + proposed week), DOCUSIGN_Horizon_Amendment_draft.pdf (redline of the amendment).

Can one of you confirm whether we can grant a conditional short-term substitution + a capped overage concession? If yes, I will prepare the DocuSign amendment for signatures and loop in Ops to apply the mapping.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Aditi Verma <aditi@horizonlabs.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary reservation hold + short-term H100 substitution for Horizon Labs

Aditya — thanks for the write-up. A couple of follow-ups before we escalate to Vanessa for signoff: 
1) Pricing impact: what is the unit economics if we map to H100 for 7 days? I need an expected overage delta and suggested concession (if any).
2) SLA / risk: does this change preemption or availability SLAs for other customers on the pool? Ops should confirm no noisy-neighbor risk.
3) Contract: can Legal accept a one-week amendment (DocuSign) that reverts automatically after 7 days?

Karthik — can you run a quick expected cost delta and a recommended concession level (percentage or fixed credit) we can offer to keep the motion moving? If the ask materially increases our exposure, propose controls (e.g., fixed overage cap + usage throttles after X tokens).

Aditi — please confirm the absolute start/end dates and whether Horizon will sign the DocuSign within 48 hours if approved.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Deal Desk — Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Michael Chu <michael.chu@horizonlabs.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 13:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary reservation hold + short-term H100 substitution for Horizon Labs

Lauren / Aditya — I ran the numbers based on the usage curve in Horizon_capacity_plan.xlsx. High level:
- Baseline committed units: 320 GPU-hours/day (A100-equivalent)
- Requested week (peak): avg 780 GPU-hours/day (Horizon plan), ~2.4x baseline for 7 days
- If we map to H100-equivalent SKUs, our marginal cost (Ops/opportunity) increases ~1.6x compared to baseline A100 pricing after accounting for allocation and scheduling churn.

Recommended concession structure (minimizes risk while keeping customer happy):
- Grant a 7-day reservation hold and temporary H100 mapping conditional on:
  • Overage rate capped at 30% premium to the committed per-GPU-hour rate for the duration (flat cap).
  • A usage circuit-breaker at 1.8x the daily committed units; if they exceed that, throttling kicks in (non-billable quota reset to committed level) to avoid runaway exposure.
  • No changes to the core SLA (we keep preemption protection as-is for Dedicated customers).
- Financial impact estimate to Redwood (7-day window): approx $18k–$26k in incremental cost net of the capped overage (range due to spot scheduling variability).

If acceptable, this is conservative: a 50% cap (their ask) would increase Redwood exposure to ~$32k–$42k. I recommend the 30% cap + circuit-breaker.

I can draft the amendment language for DocuSign (short clause: temporary SKU mapping, overage cap, auto-revert after 7 days, circuit-breaker) and attach to the deal in HubSpot.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Pricing & Deals — Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditi Verma <aditi@horizonlabs.ai>, Michael Chu <michael.chu@horizonlabs.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary reservation hold + short-term H100 substitution for Horizon Labs

Thanks for the analysis — I approve the conditional concession. Please proceed with the following exec-approved checklist: 
1) Approve: 7-day reservation hold + temporary H100 mapping with the following conditions: overage capped at 30% premium; circuit-breaker at 1.8x committed daily units.
2) Legal: prepare a short DocuSign amendment that automatically reverts the SKU mapping after the window and contains the capped overage language. We will sign only after Ops confirms there is no cross-customer SLA impact.
3) Ops: apply a temporary SKU mapping tag and enforce the circuit-breaker; confirm by EOD tomorrow when applied.
4) Sales: obtain Horizon signature within 48 hours and confirm the exact export dates in DocuSign. If Horizon cannot sign in time, we reserve the right to deny the hold.

Aditya — please send the amended DocuSign and final timeline to Aditi & Michael and copy me. Karthik — thanks for the conservative estimate; we accept the $18k–$26k exposure. Finance will track this under deal_id DEAL-6942.

One small twist: if Horizon converts this sprint into a 6-month incremental commit within 30 days, we will credit 50% of the incremental overage toward committed usage (detail to be added to amendment). That enticement is on you, Aditya — feel free to offer it if they push for deeper discounts.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
